verdict.summary: Round 5 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The change threads one QueryBudget through both variable-graph authorization resolution and engine application, aborts before mutation when authorization-time evaluation exhausts the budget, and re-materializes WAC/ACP state after a potentially partial apply whenever the authorized request could touch control data. The focused tests exercise the real PodStore and MCP tool paths: deterministic deadline and row-cap exhaustion, unchanged state on authorization-check failure, successful bounded updates, unlimited-budget compatibility, and the retained-ACL-prefix authorization invariant. The public API documentation and skills accurately describe the non-atomic apply contract, including the uncertainty around the failing operation itself. Progress is stagnant because round 4 already had no findings and this round likewise has none.
